# Code of conduct

This project is for everyone who wants to make security training better. Please help keep it
welcoming.

- Be respectful and patient, especially with people who are new to animation, Python or
  security.
- Criticise ideas and code, not people.
- No harassment, insults, discriminatory jokes or personal attacks, in issues, pull requests,
  discussions or anywhere else the project is represented.
- Don't share other people's private information.
- Security-awareness content should never mock real people, communities, regions, religions,
  accents or body types.

If something happens that makes you uncomfortable, email **ibrahimsultan4705@gmail.com**. Reports
are handled privately. The maintainer may remove content or block people who don't follow
these rules.
